display.purpose: First-run card headline. One per session; the only type above 21px.

display-mobile.purpose: The first-run headline under 900px; 40px wraps to five lines in a phone-width card.

title.purpose: Inspector panel heading; carries the tab's SHORT name.

brand.purpose: The wordmark in the command bar.

lede.purpose: The first-run paragraph. Nothing else uses it.

body.purpose: Base size for the whole interface, including fields and buttons.

label.purpose: Group headings, menu labels, preset and motion card captions.

tab.purpose: Inspector rail labels; rises to 12px on phones.

numeral.purpose: Every value the user reads: dimensions, slider outputs, timecodes, export meta, keycaps. Always tabular.

shadows.name: lift-1
shadows.purpose: Tiny objects resting on glass, e.g. the brand mark.

shadows.name: lift-2
shadows.purpose: Transient and hover-raised objects: sample badge, lifted preset swatch, drop-hint badge.

shadows.name: lift-3
shadows.purpose: Every floating pill and panel, and the toast.

shadows.name: glass-inner
shadows.purpose: Specular top highlight and inner bottom shadow that give a pane thickness.

shadows.name: accent-cast-button
shadows.purpose: The primary/export button's pink cast; the only coloured shadow on a button.

shadows.name: accent-cast-tool
shadows.purpose: An active tool in the dock.

materials.name: glass-sheen
materials.purpose: The specular top sheen over the glass body.

materials.name: glass-body
materials.value: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--glow-a) 14%, var(--glass)), var(--glass) 70%)

materials.name: edge-borrowed
materials.purpose: The lit top edge, tinted 34% by the sampled glow.

materials.name: ambient
materials.value: opacity 0.66; filter: blur(100px) saturate(1.8); three radials, two image-sampled and one fixed violet
materials.purpose: The dominant surface treatment of the room.

materials.name: plate-halo
materials.value: opacity 0.85; filter: blur(95px) saturate(2); two glow radials
materials.purpose: The light the screenshot throws into the room.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Damped release on tools and buttons: decelerate, never bounce.

motion.name: light
motion.purpose: Re-sampled room colour fades rather than cuts.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Transient surfaces: menu, toast, tool options, first-run card, sample badge.

motion.name: tab-in
motion.purpose: The panel body on tab change.

annotationInk.purpose: Content colours the user draws with. Never chrome; chrome never adopts them.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Export and other committing actions. The only place the Aurora run runs at full strength.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 13px/1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(120deg, #ff8a3d, #ff5fa2 55%, #a855f7); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.45) inset, 0 10px 26px -8px rgba(255,95,162,0.65); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5fa2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); transition-duration: 60ms; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions in the command bar and menus; transparent until touched.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #b9b3d6; font: 500 13px/1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5fa2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); transition-duration: 60ms; }

components.name: Tool
components.description: A dock tool. Muted at rest; the full Aurora run and a pink cast when active.
components.css: .ds-tool { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 15px; background: transparent; color: #b9b3d6; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tool:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: #fff; } .ds-tool:active { transform: scale(0.93); transition-duration: 60ms; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5fa2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-on, .ds-tool-on:hover { background: linear-gradient(120deg, #ff8a3d, #ff5fa2 55%, #a855f7); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -7px rgba(255,95,162,0.75); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Every text, number and select field. A recessed pane of the same glass, never a black hole.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 34px; width: 220px; padding: 0 11px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; color: #fff; caret-color: #ff5fa2; font: 400 13px/1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.34); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #ff5fa2; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11); }

components.name: Field Slider
components.description: The bar is the control: a gradient fill sweeps the field bed with a glowing leading edge, label left, tabular mono output right.
components.css: .ds-fs { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 260px; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: ew-resize; user-select: none; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-fs:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.34); } .ds-fs-fill { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,138,61,0.28), rgba(255,95,162,0.4)); transition: filter 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-fs:hover .ds-fs-fill { filter: brightness(1.25); } .ds-fs-fill::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: -1px; width: 3px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-fs-label { position: relative; font: 450 13px/1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; } .ds-fs-out { position: relative; font: 400 11px/1 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #b9b3d6; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Preset and option chips inside the inspector. On-state takes the Aurora wash, not the full run.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #b9b3d6; font: 500 12px/1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-chip:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.34); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5fa2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-on, .ds-chip-on:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255,95,162,0.6); background: rgba(255,95,162,0.2); }

components.name: Inspector Tab Rail
components.description: Every tab says what it is. Active takes a held-back amber-to-pink wash with an inset white hairline.

components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 78px; padding: 10px 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); } .ds-tab { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 9px 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #a49dc6; font: 500 10.5px/1.1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5fa2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-on, .ds-tab-on:hover { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255,138,61,0.28), rgba(255,95,162,0.32)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.16); }

components.name: Glass Pill
components.description: The shared material of all floating chrome: sheen over a glow-tinted body, a borrowed lit top edge, inner highlight and inner bottom shadow.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 58px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 29px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--glow-a, #ff8f45) 34%, rgba(255,255,255,0.34)); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.13), rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 42%, transparent), linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--glow-a, #ff8f45) 14%, rgba(26,22,46,0.5)), rgba(26,22,46,0.5) 70%); backdrop-filter: blur(34px) saturate(1.9); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(34px) saturate(1.9); box-shadow: 0 34px 80px -26px rgba(0,0,0,0.88), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.24), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-brand { font: 700 19px/1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #fff; } .ds-dims { font: 400 11px/1 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #b9b3d6; }

components.name: Sample Badge
components.description: The editor opens on a worked sample and says so. A solid-glass full pill below the plate, with a mono keycap.
components.html: This is a sample — press ⌘V to use your own
components.css: .ds-sample { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 7px 8px 7px 13px; border-radius: 99px; background: #171332; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); color: #b9b3d6; font: 400 12px/1 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-kbd { font: 500 11.5px/1 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: #fff; } .ds-sample-x { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: #a49dc6; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sample-x:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); }

narrative.overview:
Shotframe's editor is a deep indigo night with a light in it. The room is almost black but never neutral: it is violet-black, and the only real illumination comes from two places — the screenshot plate, which throws its own halo, and an ambient field of three enormous soft radials, two of which are sampled live from the user's own image. Chrome does not sit on this room; it floats above it as heavy, specular glass pills that pick up the room's colour through a 34px blur and hand it back as a lit top edge.

Density is high but quiet. The interface is built almost entirely from 34px controls, 11px labels and mono numerals, packed tightly so that nothing competes with the plate. The one place the world raises its voice is the accent, which is not a colour but a light: a 120-degree run from amber through pink to violet, used only where something is running, armed or on. Everything else is glass, edge and text.

The arrangement is the thesis. This world refuses the docked-toolbar-plus-settings-form layout every screenshot tool ships. Nothing is edge-docked: the command bar is a centred pill, the tool dock is a pill, and the inspector is a floating rounded panel with a 20px margin of room visible on every side.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo-black room, never grey, never neutral
Chrome is pills and floating panels; nothing docks to an edge
Heavy specular glass: 34px blur at 1.9 saturation, top sheen, lit top edge, inner bottom shadow
The accent is a gradient light source, used only for state
Ambient light is sampled from the user's image and is the dominant surface treatment
Every user-read numeral is tabular mono

rules.name: The One Lit Object Rule
rules.body: The screenshot plate is the brightest thing on screen. No chrome surface may out-glow it; glass stays at glass values and only the plate carries a halo (0.85 opacity, 95px blur).

rules.name: The Borrowed Light Rule
rules.body: Room colour is never authored per-surface. Anything that should feel lit reads --glow-a / --glow-b, which the image publishes at runtime. A new surface that wants warmth mixes the glow token in; it does not pick a hue.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-State Rule
rules.body: The Aurora run means "this is on, focused, selected or about to export". Never use it for emphasis, decoration or hierarchy. Where a gradient will not fit, use the flat accent — never a fourth pink.

rules.name: The Dim-Is-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: --dim never carries a glyph. Text bottoms out at --faint.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every numeral a user reads is Spline Sans Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. A dragged value must never reflow the control around it.

rules.name: The Labelled Tab Rule
rules.body: No tab, and no icon-only control, ships without a visible label or an accessible name. Icons never carry meaning alone.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Archivo for language, Spline Sans Mono for number. There is no third family in the chrome.

rules.name: The Floating Chrome Rule
rules.body: No chrome surface touches a viewport edge. Every pill and panel keeps a visible margin of room on all sides, at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Real Height Rule
rules.body: Phone layout anchors to --plate-h, the canvas's measured height, never to a guessed constant.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Borders Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by light: a lit top edge, an inner highlight, an inner shadow and a large diffuse cast. A four-sided full-strength border is never the separator.

rules.name: The Borrowed Edge Rule
rules.body: The lit top edge is not a fixed white. It mixes 34% of the sampled glow into --edge-lit, so the chrome's highlight changes colour with the user's image.

rules.name: The No Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Every surface, control and overlay is rounded. If a new element needs a radius and no token fits, it takes --r-control.

dos: Do float new chrome as a pill or rounded panel with a visible margin of room on every side.
Do separate surfaces with a lit top edge, an inner highlight and a diffuse cast — never a full-strength four-sided border.
Do mix --glow-a / --glow-b into anything that should read as lit, instead of authoring a hue.
Do reserve the Aurora run for state: primary action, active tool, active tab.
Do build recessed fields from white alpha (--well / --well-deep) — a darker pane of the same glass.
Do set every user-read numeral in Spline Sans Mono with tabular figures.
Do give every icon-only control a visible label or an accessible name.
donts: Don't let any chrome surface out-glow the canvas plate.
Don't use --dim on text; --faint is the floor.
Don't use the accent for emphasis, decoration or hierarchy.
Don't introduce a third type family or a system-UI display face into the chrome.
Don't cut a recessed field as a black hole; it is glass, darker.
Don't add a hard offset shadow; every shadow in this world is large and diffuse, and the only coloured cast is the accent's.
Don't ship a square corner in the chrome.
Don't use a bouncing, springing or elastic curve.
Don't dock chrome into a solid frame or wrap settings in a form panel with structural rules — that is the arrangement this world exists to refuse.
acceptedDeviations: Resolved: the command bar is now a centred, width-capped pill (min(1180px, 100% − 32px), 29px radius), which matches the direction contract's "floating at top centre". The previous full-bleed deviation is closed, and the rule for new top-level chrome changes with it.

Outstanding: the direction contract comment in index.html still describes the previous world (near-black room, smoked glass, one amber accent). The build is the truth; the comment needs rewriting. Flagged, not edited.
openDecisions: How far the glass goes — partly taken. The specular top sheen and the inner bottom shadow now exist, so a pane reads as having thickness. Still open: no specular falloff along a pane's length (a 1180px bar is lit identically at both ends), no near/far weighting (bar, dock and inspector share one blur, one edge and one shadow), and no edge refraction where a pane crosses the plate's light. Taking the rest deepens the signature; leaving it keeps the chrome quieter behind the screenshot. The product owner decides.
